why: A durable poster reference for high-contrast hierarchy, disciplined whitespace, and type-led cultural communication without decorative overload.

compositions.title: Oversized type as image
compositions.study: Large type carries the visual mass while smaller metadata locks to a strict axis.
compositions.reuse: Use when a poster needs authority and quick distance readability.

compositions.title: Asymmetric grid tension
compositions.study: Composition feels dynamic because text blocks are offset inside a rigorous grid.
compositions.reuse: Use for event posters, conference visuals, and cultural announcements.

assets.notes: Use original typography choices; do not copy source lettering.
assets.reuse: Build a fresh type scale and lockup from the observed hierarchy.

assets.notes: Palette should be compact and high contrast.
assets.reuse: Reserve one accent for event identity or callout information.

implementation.notes: Reusable as poster, social crop, or hero key visual.
